title: He Was the Hero for 30 Years — Now Akshay Kumar Plays the Monster in Priyadarshan's 'Haiwaan'
excerpt: Saif Ali Khan as a blind man hunted by a psychopath, Kajol, Bobby Deol, Mohanlal's surprise cameo, and the filmmaker who just made ₹293 crore with 'Bhooth Bangla' — all arriving September 11
body:
There's a moment in every Bollywood career when a superstar stops playing it safe, and after three decades of being the guy who saves the day, Akshay Kumar has finally decided to be the one who ruins it.

Haiwaan, the new suspense thriller from Priyadarshan, locked its release date yesterday: September 11, 2026. And the cast list reads less like a movie and more like a dare. Saif Ali Khan stars as the protagonist — reportedly a blind man fighting to protect a young girl from a relentless psychopathic killer. That killer? Akshay Kumar, in what may be the most electrifying role announcement of the year.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=psGnGJKGyYU

The two haven't shared a frame in 18 years. Not since Tashan in 2008 — a film we'd all rather forget, but one that at least proved these two generate genuine heat when they're in the same room. Before that, it was the effortless cool of Main Khiladi Tu Anari and Yeh Dillagi, films that defined '90s Bollywood swagger. Now they're back, and the energy is entirely different: darker, meaner, and infinitely more interesting.

"First is always the script. Then the actor follows. I cannot say, 'I am gonna make a film with Mohanlal and Akshay Kumar together.' You can't — you will never get a script then." — Priyadarshan

That quote alone tells you what kind of filmmaker is behind the camera. Priyadarshan has 60 blockbusters to his name and isn't about to start making vanity projects. Haiwaan — which translates to "beast" — is inspired by the critically acclaimed Malayalam thriller Oppam, which starred Mohanlal as a blind caretaker who outwits a killer in a high-rise apartment complex. In the Hindi version, Mohanlal himself shows up in a cameo — a passing-of-the-baton moment that's going to set cinephiles on fire.

And then there's the rest of the cast, which Priyadarshan has assembled with the restraint of someone hosting a dinner party and inviting literally everyone who matters. Kajol is in. Bobby Deol is in. Boman Irani is in. Shriya Pilgaonkar — fresh off an exceptional run in streaming — and Saiyami Kher take key roles that reportedly bring emotional depth to what is otherwise a relentless cat-and-mouse thriller. Jisshu Sengupta rounds out the ensemble. Written by Rohan Shankar, the man behind Saiyaara, with cinematography by Divakar Mani and music by Pritam, every department feels stacked for something special.

The film wrapped shooting in December 2025, with Priyadarshan sharing cake-cutting photos of Saif and the crew — a far cry from the darkness the film apparently contains. Reports describe a plot revolving around obsession, pursuit, and the terrifying vulnerability of a protagonist who literally cannot see what's coming for him. If the source material is anything to go by, Saif's performance will demand something raw and internal — the kind of stillness that makes great thrillers work. And Akshay going full villain? The man who built an empire on patriotism and comedy playing a psychopath for the first time in his career? That's not a casting choice. That's a statement.

The timing is immaculate. Priyadarshan and Akshay's last collaboration, Bhooth Bangla, currently sits as the third highest-grossing Hindi film of 2026 at nearly ₹293 crore worldwide. That film proved the director still knows how to fill theatres. Haiwaan will test whether he can empty them — in the best possible way, leaving audiences rattled rather than reassured.

KVN Productions and Thespian Films are producing, with Venkat K Narayana and Shailaja Desai Fenn as producers. Sony Pictures Networks India has already snapped up the digital, satellite, and music rights, meaning the film will stream on SonyLIV after its theatrical run. For diaspora audiences in the US, UK, and Canada, expect a wide day-and-date theatrical release — a Priyadarshan thriller with Akshay and Saif is going to command screens.

September 11. Mark it. The beast is coming.
